name: US State Choropleth
description: A US state choropleth with quantile color bins, hover tooltips, and an optional national-average headline number above the map. Values join to states by full state name. The ramp defaults to the active theme's diverging palette — most state-level policy and health metrics read best against a national center — and a D3 scheme name can override it. Use it when the story is geographic variation in one number.
